snippet.title: Mazestalker: The Veil of Silenos - Trailer | GamingUp Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Enter a forgotten world of ancient mysteries in Mazestalker: The Veil of Silenos, an isometric puzzle adventure focused on exploration, discovery and environmental storytelling.

Take on the role of treasure hunter Yve Allard and explore handcrafted labyrinths filled with hidden paths, switches, moving structures, bridges and perspective-based puzzles. Uncover artifacts and traces of an ancient civilization while following an expedition from the Treasure Hunters' Guild deeper into the valley.

Gain new abilities, return to previously explored areas to discover new paths and slowly piece together the secrets of a world where understanding its history is a puzzle of its own.

Wishlist Mazestalker: The Veil of Silenos now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3218310/Mazestalker_The_Veil_of_Silenos/

Coming to PC in 2027.
